title: Concept: OS command execution via exec.Command (go) — review required
description: In go, exec.Command executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (exec.Command with separate args (no shell)) are go-specific.
applicability: go codebases that launch external processes through exec.Command; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
